payload.summary: Implemented and independently validated bounded content reconciliation with durable claim fencing, exact ownership, canonical retry, and authenticated API/CLI controls.
completed_work: Added claim-generation/protocol fencing, exact Content ownership, Summary provenance, and append-only reconciliation audit storage.
Added guarded URL and Summary domain commits, connection-scoped canonical retry, bounded dry-run/apply reconciliation, and authenticated API/client/CLI controls.

Passed the exact 6,146-test cumulative suite, strict OpenSpec, contract drift, 192 CLI gen-eval tests, 111 surface tests, 23 service/query-plan tests, 11 concurrency tests, and 2 URL recovery E2E tests.
Resolved the independent High finding by refreshing locked Content state before ownership checks and hardened malformed URL evidence handling.

decisions.title: Fence domain commits with exact claim ownership
decisions.rationale: Persisted operation, generation, phase, and owner version make late-worker writes fail closed.

decisions.title: Keep reconciliation one-page and default-off
decisions.rationale: Dry-run is read-only and apply requires an explicit server gate while canonical retry remains authoritative.

decisions.title: Reuse the existing status index
decisions.rationale: The 10,001-row plan scanned one candidate, so an additional ownership index was not justified.

next_steps: Plan and refine RI-09 production telemetry and out-of-band alerting using RI-08 terminal and reconciliation evidence.
